job.prompt:
Create a peaceful top-down fantasy adventure called The Frozen Garden.

The entire adventure takes place on ONE continuous map.

Half of the world is a lush magical forest full of trees, flowers, small ponds, and wooden pathways. The other half is a frozen landscape with snowy trees, slippery ice, and ancient ruins.

There should be a beautiful natural transition between the two environments, not an abrupt straight line.

A healer living in the forest asks me to retrieve two magical flowers from the snowy ruins.

Walking on ice should feel slippery, while walking through the forest should have normal movement.

Add animated environmental details, NPC dialogue, an understandable quest system, and appropriate interactions.

No enemies or combat. The game ends when I return the flowers to the healer.
limitations: Animated environmental details beyond standard biome tiles
